question: In a certain code language, 'CURD' is written as '342184' and 'BREAD' is written as '2181024'. How will 'BUTTER' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic:** Consonants are multiplied by 1 and Vowels are multiplied by 2.

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39293b0a629abb72329307a78015242857fb64e5b708b2ae3b1fc3333f293ba6.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87d4deff9e824ff0c683d9e40efc6e1701706f8f649eb9471efd64c1be8f927c.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b560062e860a3dfe5e7393e5fd2c169cd3a85910c989be67e49754ca396a273.png] 

Hence, '**24220201018**' is the correct answer.
